title: TIBET: Identifying and Evaluating Biases in Text-to-Image Generative Models
measurement_description: Detection and quantification of stereotypical biases in text-to-image generations for prompts involving religious contexts, concepts, or figures. The system dynamically identifies relevant bias axes, including religious bias, for any given prompt.
findings: The proposed TIBET framework can dynamically identify 'Religious Bias' as a relevant axis for analysis when given prompts with religious contexts (e.g., 'an old man at a church'), a capability that is lacking in methods that rely on a predefined set of bias axes. The paper demonstrates this capability as part of its general framework but does not provide specific quantitative results for religious biases.
